# Earth Travels India

> Premium tour agency in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India. IATA accredited (Code 14352726). 15+ years of trust, 15,000+ happy travellers. Domestic and international custom tour packages, visa assistance, travel insurance, cruise bookings, and luxury rail journeys.

## About Earth Travels India

Earth Travels India is a family-run, IATA-accredited travel agency based in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India, operating since 2011. The agency specialises in crafting tailor-made holiday packages for families, couples, and groups — from Kashmir valleys to Maldives overwater villas, Dubai city breaks to European multi-country tours. Every package includes transparent itemised pricing in INR with zero hidden charges.

## Key Services

- [Tour Packages](https://earthtravelsindia.in/packages): 50+ curated domestic and international tour packages starting from ₹9,500 per person
- [Destinations](https://earthtravelsindia.in/destinations): 42+ handpicked destinations across India, Southeast Asia, Middle East, Europe, and Islands
- [Visa Assistance](https://earthtravelsindia.in/visa): End-to-end visa processing for 30+ countries including documentation, appointment scheduling, and application tracking
- [Travel Insurance](https://earthtravelsindia.in/insurance): Comprehensive travel insurance plans covering medical emergencies, trip cancellation, baggage loss, and flight delays
- [Cruise Bookings](https://earthtravelsindia.in/cruises): Premium cruise packages on Cordelia, Costa, and international cruise lines
- [Luxury Rail Journeys](https://earthtravelsindia.in/rails): Palace on Wheels, Maharajas' Express, and other luxury Indian rail experiences
